editorial:
Ever wonder how a fitness model becomes a wrestling icon? You get to see exactly how that happened here. This documentary takes you behind the curtain of the WWE to show Trish Stratus's rise to the top. It feels like a personal scrapbook of her early years, mixing home videos with big arena matches. You will see her struggle to be taken seriously in a world dominated by men, all while keeping a fun and energetic vibe that makes the time fly by.

What really works is seeing the raw footage of her training and the honest way she talks about her growth. The pacing is quick, though some of the segments feel a bit like a long commercial for her brand. Still, it is a great ride for anyone who likes sports history. If you want the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection for those crisp details. It is a perfect watch for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want something inspiring and upbeat.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing Trish finally reaching the top of the mountain. You see her win the Women's Championship and earn the respect of the fans and her peers. Instead of a shocking twist, the end focuses on her legacy and her transition from a model to a legitimate athlete. It closes with a look at her future goals, leaving you feeling happy that her hard work actually paid off in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves professional wrestling or success stories.
